title: lesquerella alpina var. laevis
intro: Lesquerella alpina var. laevis, commonly known as smooth yellow montia, is a plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Lesquerella alpina var. laevis include soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include fatty acids, particularly erucic acid, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects, although more research is needed to fully understand its properties and benefits.
